name: Singularity Notebook
description: Fork of Ink Notebook with low-latency Boox pen input via the Singularity Notebook Companion app. Replaces Ink Notebook: uninstall it first. Handwritten notebooks like the Boox Notes app – a fast pen engine for e-ink tablets with pens, highlighter, erasers, lasso, shapes and paper templates – and your handwriting as text with Azure OCR, live diagrams, PDF annotation and papers from arXiv.
author: Stefan Mayer
